item.title: No clinical trial evidence supports fexofenadine and famotidine for menopausal symptoms
item.description: The viral combination of fexofenadine and famotidine for menopausal symptoms is based on a plausible histamine hypothesis but has never been tested in clinical trials.

item.title: Lower education and birthplace linked to lower ICU admission in Sweden during COVID-19
item.description: In Sweden, COVID-19 patients with lower education or from outside Northwestern Europe/North America were less likely to be admitted to intensive care.

item.title: New tool uncovers potential cancer targets in 'junk DNA'
item.description: A QIMR Berghofer-led team developed a powerful tool to explore the vast non-coding regions of the human genome, revealing potential cancer targets.

item.title: Micro-LED mask improves skin elasticity beyond injections alone
item.description: Home beauty devices are popular, but conventional LED masks have limitations. A new micro-LED mask may offer better skin elasticity results than injections alone.
